title: Binary projective symmetries of the Hayes quotient
statement: For every positive degree n, exactly two elements of PGL_2(GF(2)) preserve the complete family of monic degree-n polynomials and induce an action on its reciprocal high-coefficient Hayes quotient: the identity and x->x+1. Every other projective element moves infinity; its transformed leading coefficient is F(a) for a finite binary point a, and F=(x+a)^n is an explicit monic degree-drop witness.

evidence.supports: All six projective elements, the two infinity stabilizers, the unique nonidentity quotient symmetry, and four explicit degree-drop witnesses.
evidence.notes: The universal proof is the stabilizer-of-infinity calculation. Degrees through 64 are mutation controls, not quantifier evidence.

provenance.source: complete enumeration of PGL_2(GF(2)) and the homogenized fixed-degree action

notes: This closes a second-projective-symmetry shortcut but supplies no WITT-LOW or REL bound.
